ops.new_text: The frozen primary object remains the planar, no-eclipse, equilateral three-disk flow with disk radius \texttt{a}, center separation \texttt{d=6a}, and Euclidean free-flight time between collisions. The symbolic alphabet is the labeled set \(\{1,2,3\}\), with consecutive equal symbols forbidden. A prospective oriented owner is a realized primitive cyclic word: cyclic rotations are one owner, reversal is retained as a separate oriented owner linked by \texttt{reverse\_id}, and permutations of disk labels are not quotiented because the labels are bound to the frozen geometry. A repeated word maps to its primitive root with an explicit repetition exponent. Every accepted code class must carry a witness to one realized physical periodic orbit before it may enter a coefficient ledger. The pointwise roof must be computed from the registered collision geometry, not fitted from inherited periodic totals. None of these owner or realization records has been constructed here.

The bounded contribution is a prospective integration of a physical-roof input contract, operator and coefficient eligibility gates, a five-channel error theorem template, lawful controls, deterministic replay, and an optional nontransfer module for one frozen classical-dynamics system. The constituent ideas are not claimed as new in isolation, and the frozen corpus is not an exhaustive novelty review. \paragraph{Prospective typed theorem template.} Let \(B\) be a declared complex Banach space with norm \(\lVert\cdot\rVert_B\), let \(\Omega\Subset\mathbb{C}\) be a compact declared parameter domain, and let \(L_{s,\rho}:B\to B\) be the normalized operator associated with a registered roof \(\rho\). The intended output functional is \(D_\rho(s)=\det(I-L_{s,\rho})\) on \(\Omega\), conditional on a recorded trace-class or nuclearity theorem and coefficient correspondence. A future certificate must name the spaces, norms, maps, hypotheses, dependency graph, and symbolic constants needed to consume the following five raw channels; every presently unknown field is \texttt{UNASSIGNED}, not a numerical value:

Write the raw bounds as \(\varepsilon_{\rm roof}\), \(\varepsilon_{\rm orbit}\), \(\varepsilon_{\rm proj}\), \(\varepsilon_{\rm eval}\), and \(\varepsilon_{\rm round}\). A valid theorem instance must supply a roof-to-operator constant \(C_{\rho\to L}\), coefficient and projection propagation constants, and a determinant condition function \(\kappa_D(s)\), all with stated hypotheses and domains, so that a composed statement has the prospective form
\[
 \sup_{s\in\Omega}|\widehat D_\rho(s)-D_\rho(s)|\leq\sup_{s\in\Omega}\kappa_D(s)\,\mathcal{C}(C_{\rho\to L}\varepsilon_{\rm roof},\varepsilon_{\rm orbit},\varepsilon_{\rm proj},\varepsilon_{\rm eval},\varepsilon_{\rm round}).
\]
The function \(\mathcal{C}\) must record shared dependencies instead of assuming independence or summing overlapping channels. If a space, map, theorem hypothesis, constant, dependency treatment, domain, or output tolerance is absent, the sole disposition is \texttt{ERROR\_CONTRACT\_NOT\_EVALUABLE}. No constant, tolerance, enclosure, or scientific value is assigned here.

The theorem template distinguishes local calibration from a uniform enclosure. Its required fields are \texttt{input\_space}, \texttt{roof\_norm}, \texttt{operator\_space}, \texttt{complex\_domain}, \texttt{operator\_map}, \texttt{coefficient\_map}, \texttt{raw\_channels}, \texttt{dependency\_ledger}, \texttt{conditioning\_functional}, \texttt{output\_functional}, and \texttt{output\_tolerance}. Agreement at selected parameters or on a precision ladder may test code paths but cannot fill any theorem field. Conditioning near zeros or spectral features must be included in \(\kappa_D\). At present the domain, constants, functional tolerance, and all raw bounds are \texttt{UNASSIGNED}; hence the template is type-readable but \texttt{ERROR\_CONTRACT\_NOT\_EVALUABLE}.

Gate~5 uses four prospective roofs on one frozen callable interface. The primary roof is \(\rho_{\rm phys}=\tau_{6a}\), derived from the unchanged \texttt{d=6a} collision geometry. The unit control is \(\rho_{\rm unit}=c_0\) with a positive constant \(c_0\) frozen before output access. A lawful shuffled control is \(\rho_{\rm shuf}=\rho_{\rm phys}\circ\phi\), where \(\phi\) must be a predeclared adjacency-preserving H\"older automorphism of the coding interface; if no such map is supplied, the shuffle is \texttt{CONTROL\_NOT\_EVALUABLE}. The neighboring-geometry control is \(\rho_\delta=\tau_{(6+\delta)a}\), where an exact nonzero rational \(\delta\) and the corresponding no-eclipse geometry must be frozen before use. This last roof is a control and does not alter the primary \texttt{d=6a} system. A comparison functional and tolerance remain \texttt{UNASSIGNED}; no fidelity or control result exists.

Gate~6 lies outside the minimum physical-determinant certificate. It becomes active only if, before result access, a record freezes two lawful roofs on the same symbolic system, a positive scale convention, the exact cohomological relation under test, a theorem-to-object hypothesis map, and a periodic-sum mismatch predicate with certified uncertainty handling. Without that record the state is \texttt{NOT\_ACTIVATED}, which is a disclosed absence rather than a waiver. If activated, a certified mismatch may yield \texttt{NONTRANSFER\_CERTIFIED} for the predeclared relation; otherwise the terminal state is \texttt{NONTRANSFER\_NOT\_PROVED}. Neither state licenses a universal inequivalence claim, and no Gate-6 execution or result exists.

The certificate is a directed acyclic graph. Gate~1 consumes frozen geometry and owner policy and would emit a hashed pointwise-roof and orbit-owner ledger; Gate~2 consumes that hash and would emit an operator specification and theorem-hypothesis receipt; Gate~3 consumes both and would emit a coefficient-correspondence ledger; Gate~4 consumes those ledgers plus five uncertainty-channel records and would emit a domain-specific enclosure receipt; Gate~5 consumes the same coding, operator, error, and replay interfaces and would emit a physical-versus-control comparison receipt. Gates~1--5 are the mandatory chain. Gate~6 consumes a separately registered roof pair and theorem map only when activated. Every gate record must name input and output hashes, uncertainty channels, validator version, downstream consumers, and prohibited claims. The closed states are \texttt{NOT\_STARTED}, \texttt{PREREQUISITE\_BLOCKED}, \texttt{EVALUABLE}, \texttt{PASSED}, \texttt{FAILED}, and \texttt{NOT\_EVALUABLE}; Gate~6 additionally admits \texttt{NOT\_ACTIVATED}.
